refusal.taskBlocked: The task cannot start yet: it waits for its dependencies or its status.
refusal.inputInvalid: The workflow cannot accept this input.
refusal.returnNotAllowed: The workflow cannot return to that step.
refusal.localConfigModified: The worktree's local configuration (.nevo/local/config.yaml) was changed, added by hand or cannot be read. Move or delete it, then close again.
refusal.busy: The specification is busy with another change. Try again in a moment.
refusal.draftConflict: A draft you keep depends on a draft you unticked. Keep both, or untick both.
refusal.tasksOpen: The specification cannot complete while tasks are open: {{tasks}}. Finish or cancel them first.

attention.resumeFailed: The task could not be resumed. Open the task to see what you can do now.

progress.barNoteEnded: The bar counts every task except cancelled and ended ones.

row.holdsFinishUnnamed: the step cannot finish while this task is on hold

page.failed: The tasks could not be loaded.
page.groupEmpty: No tasks in this group now

article.proposalNote: This is a proposal, not a current rule. Search leaves proposals out unless you include them.

related.heading: Related

state.notAvailable: This document is no longer available in this workspace

superseded.title: This document was superseded
superseded.description: {{id}} is no longer current documentation, so it is not shown.

deprecated.title: This document is deprecated
deprecated.description: {{id}} is no longer current documentation, so it is not shown.

skipped.title: This document is skipped: it has errors

articleFailed.title: The document cannot be shown right now
articleFailed.description: Reading it failed. Try again in a moment.

notConfigured.title: No project documentation
notConfigured.description: {{workspace}} has no documentation folder. The reader shows the Markdown documents under the folder set as docs.root in .nevo/config.yaml (docs/ by default).
notConfigured.descriptionRoot: {{workspace}} has no documentation folder. The reader shows the Markdown documents under the folder set as docs.root in .nevo/config.yaml, here {{docsRoot}}/.

empty.title: No documents yet
empty.description: The documentation folder of {{workspace}} has no current documents.

allSkipped.title: Documentation files exist, but none passed validation
allSkipped.description: The reader skips every document in {{workspace}} because each has errors. Fix them in the files below.

unavailable.title: This workspace is unavailable right now
unavailable.description: The folder {{folder}} cannot be read, for example while its branch is being switched or after the folder was moved. Choose another workspace or try again.

notServed.title: Project documentation is not available in the demo
notServed.description: The demo runs on sample data without a project, so there is no documentation folder to read. Start SpecFlow in a project to read its documentation.

docsUnavailable.title: The documentation cannot be read right now
docsUnavailable.description: Its settings could not be read, or reading it failed. Try again in a moment.

failed.title: The documentation cannot be shown right now
failed.description: Reading it failed. Try again in a moment.

forbidden.title: No access to the project documentation
forbidden.description: Your role in this project does not include reading its documentation. Ask a project administrator for access.

workspacePicker.label: Workspace
workspacePicker.localChangesExplained: Local changes: reading and search include uncommitted changes, new files too

unavailable.checkout-mismatch: Folder is no longer this workspace
unavailable.git-membership-mismatch: No longer a Git worktree of this project

errors.ownerRequestRefused: SpecFlow refused this request because the page was not opened from SpecFlow's own address. Open SpecFlow at the address it runs on and try again.
errors.ownerCredentialRequired: This browser is not paired, or its pairing was revoked. Pair it again to continue.
errors.capacity: Too many pairing requests are waiting on this computer. Wait a couple of minutes, or on a paired device choose Pair a device, then Clear waiting requests.
errors.unavailable: SpecFlow could not answer. Check that it is running and try again.
errors.notUsed: This SpecFlow does not use device pairing.

screen.title: Pair this device
screen.description: Only a paired device can approve, finish or close work in SpecFlow. Pairing is done once per browser.
screen.qrInvalid: This QR code is no longer valid. It works once, for about two minutes. Show a new one on a paired device, or use the code below.

code.label: This device's pairing code
code.expired: This code expired. Codes work once, for about two minutes.
code.lost: This code is no longer valid. A paired device may have cleared it.
code.rateLimited: Too many pairing codes were asked for from this device. You can ask for a new one {{when}}.

approve.title: Approve it from a paired device
approve.step1: On a device that is already paired, open your account menu.
approve.step2: Choose Pair a device and enter the code above.
approve.step3: Check that it names this device, then approve.
approve.qrHint: On a phone, you can instead choose Show QR code there and scan it with this phone's camera.

first.title: First device? Use SpecFlow's own code
first.body: When no device is paired yet, SpecFlow shows a one-time code in the window or terminal that started it.
first.bodyHeadless: No device is paired yet, and this SpecFlow runs without a window to show a code in. It saved a one-time code on the machine running SpecFlow, readable only by the account that runs it. Read it there, for example over SSH, and enter it here. Until a device is paired, no agent starts.
first.bodyHeadlessRepair: This SpecFlow was started to pair a device again and saved a one-time code on the machine running it, readable only by the account that runs it. Read it there, for example over SSH, and enter it here.
first.label: Code from SpecFlow
first.invalid: This code is not valid. It may be mistyped, used already, or replaced by a restart. Check the code on the machine running SpecFlow and try again.
first.rateLimited: Too many tries. You can try again {{when}}.

paired.byApproval: A paired device approved it. You can now approve, finish and close work here.
paired.byQr: Paired with a QR code from a paired device. You can now approve, finish and close work here.
paired.alertBody: It stays paired until you revoke it in Paired devices, on any paired device.
paired.byInitialCode: Paired with SpecFlow's own code. You can now approve, finish and close work here.

dialog.title: Pair a device
dialog.description: A paired device can approve, finish and close work. Pair only a device you are holding or can see.
dialog.codeLabel: Code shown on the other device
dialog.invalid: This code is not valid or has expired. On the other device, choose New code and enter the new one here.
dialog.expired: This code expired. On the other device, choose New code and enter the new one here.
dialog.rateLimited: Too many tries. You can try again {{when}}.
dialog.sameAddress: The address is the same for every program on this computer, and a browser name can be faked.
dialog.attention: Approve only a code you see on a device you hold. If you did not start this on a device of your own, do not approve it.
dialog.successBody: It can now approve, finish and close work.
dialog.clearHint: Use it when a device cannot get a code.
dialog.qrLabel: QR code for pairing a phone
dialog.qrHint: Scan it with the phone's camera. It works once, for {{time}} more.
dialog.qrExpired: This QR code expired. QR codes work once, for about two minutes.
dialog.qrLocalhost: You opened SpecFlow as {{host}}, an address only this computer can reach. A phone cannot open this QR code. Open SpecFlow at this computer's network address to pair a phone.
dialog.qrUnavailable: The QR code cannot be shown in this version of SpecFlow. Pair the phone with its code instead.

devices.title: Paired devices
devices.description: These browsers can approve, finish and close work in SpecFlow. Revoke one you no longer use or do not recognise.
devices.failed: The paired devices could not be loaded.
devices.revokeOtherBody: It can no longer approve, finish or close anything until it is paired again. Work it already did stays.
devices.revokeThisBody: This browser can no longer approve, finish or close anything; it shows Pair this device until a paired device approves it again. Work it already did stays.
devices.revokeLastBody: No device will be paired. To pair one again you need the machine running SpecFlow: restart it with --pair and use the code it gives. Until a device is paired, no agent starts.
devices.revokeFailed: The device could not be revoked.

waiting.title: Agents cannot start while a pairing code is waiting
waiting.body: SpecFlow was started with --pair and wrote a one-time pairing code on its machine. No agent starts while that code can be read, so an agent can never use it to pair itself.
waiting.action: Pair a device with the code, or cancel the waiting code here.
waiting.fileLeft: The code is cancelled and agents can start, but its file could not be deleted. Delete it on the machine running SpecFlow.
